alerts.title: UK Pays Record Sums to Balance Grid as Transmission Falls Behind
alerts.summary: The UK is among the most ambitious states when it comes to a transition to a net-zero economy. Also, the UK is struggling with some of the highest electricity prices in Europe—and is paying significant sums to maintain grid balance, even when its wind installations are generating plenty of electricity. Normally, the cost of maintaining a balanced grid, meaning stable and secure supply of electricity, is the highest when the weather affects alternative energy sources.
